texte.Les scénarios, les délais de réaction et: The scenarios, the reaction times and the selection of measures — everything else is justified against them.
texte.Les sept exigences du Chapitre III, Sect: The seven requirements of Chapter III, Section # of the regulation — one by one, with the approach retained for each.
texte.Les sept exigences essentielles applicab: Are the seven essential requirements applicable to your systems identified one by one?
texte.Les seuils sous lesquels un score de con: The thresholds below which a confidence score raises an alert
texte.Les seuils sous lesquels un score déclen: The thresholds below which a score raises an alert must appear in the instructions for use: it is one of the seven required items.
texte.Les soixante-cinq paragraphes normatifs,: The sixty-five normative clauses, from the management system to performance evaluation.
texte.Les sorties sont examinées APRÈS avoir é: Outputs are examined AFTER being produced, on an interface that carries the log of outputs, their inputs, the confidence scores, the associated alerts and the system version.
texte.Les spécifications des notifications que: The specifications of the notifications the deployer must implement, since you do not implement them
texte.Les spécifications techniques, dont les: The technical specifications, including the standards applied — and, where they are not applied in full, the means employed.
texte.Les systèmes et procédures d'archivage d: The systems and procedures for archiving documentation and information.
texte.Les systèmes et procédures de gestion de: The data management systems and procedures.
texte.Les techniques et procédures de concepti: The design and design-control techniques and procedures.
texte.Les techniques et procédures de développ: The development, control and quality assurance techniques and procedures.
texte.Les tests de pénétration fondés sur la m: Threat-led penetration testing, whose obligation is determined by the authorities, and not by the entity itself.
texte.Les trente sous-articles du corps de la: The thirty sub-clauses of the main body of the standard.
texte.Les trente-deux sous-articles du corps d: The thirty-two sub-clauses of the main body of the standard.
texte.Les trente-quatre points de contrôle de: The thirty-four audit checkpoints, in eight sections, from prohibited practices to general-purpose models — each with an answer.
texte.Les trois états sont ce qui rend la prév: The three states are what makes technical prevention verifiable: with no state, there is no proving that an unreviewed output triggered nothing.
texte.Les usages d'IA déjà en place que person: The AI uses already in place that nobody has declared, case by case, and what to do about them.
texte.Les vingt et une exigences essentielles: The twenty-one essential requirements of Annex I, parts I and II.
texte.Les vingt objectifs de sécurité, leur ré: The twenty security objectives, their split across four pillars, the number of means in each, the reservation of objectives # to # to essential entities, and the mapping table to the provisions of the directive.
texte.Les États membres adoptent et publient l: Member States adopt and publish their transposing law
texte.Les États membres peuvent identifier com: Member States may identify as essential or important entities that appear in no annex, under article #, paragraph #, points (b) to (e). The module does not know these national designations: it accepts them as a declaration.
texte.Les États établissent la liste des entit: Member States draw up the list of essential and important entities; the entities concerned notify the competent authority of their name, contact details, sector and the Member States where they operate
texte.Les écarts se documentent : c'est l'un d: Deviations are documented: it is one of the seven items the technical documentation must carry.
texte.Les étapes du cycle de vie sont-elles dé: Are the lifecycle stages determined, with their processes and procedures?
texte.Lieux — régions ou pays — où les service: Locations — regions or countries — where the services are provided and where the data are processed and stored, and the duty to give notice before any change
texte.Liste des entités financières clientes,: List of financial-entity clients, with for each its type and the geographical location from which it is served
texte.Liste des prestataires DÉJÀ désignés cri: List of providers ALREADY designated critical that rely on the applicant's services
texte.Lister toutes les activités et tous les: List every activity and every service, with a named owner and the systems that carry them — then keep that list up to date.
texte.Lorsqu'un acte sectoriel impose des mesu: Where a sectoral act imposes risk-management measures or the notification of significant incidents with an at-least-equivalent effect, the relevant provisions of the directive — including those on supervision and enforcement under chapter VII — do not apply. Where the sectoral act does not cover every entity in the sector, the directive continues to apply to the others.
texte.Lorsqu'un délai de réaction ne laisse ma: Where a reaction time materially leaves no room for human intervention under real conditions, have you recorded it in the risk management file, together with the minimum intervention time you adopt?
texte.Lorsqu'une seule personne désignée super: Where a single designated person oversees several scenarios, have you demonstrated and justified in the technical documentation that they can do so without cognitive overload or conflict?
texte.Lorsque la personne désignée rejette une: Where the designated person rejects an output before it is executed, does the system refrain from executing it, record it, and stay stable without replaying it?
texte.Lorsque la personne désignée substitue s: Where the designated person substitutes their own output, is the automatic execution path interrupted, the human alternative integrated, and BOTH outputs — the system's and yours — recorded?
texte.Lorsque le délai expire un jour de week-: Where the deadline falls on a weekend day or a public holiday in the Member State of the reporting entity, the submission may be made by noon on the next working day at the latest.
texte.Lorsque le prestataire appartient à un g: Where the provider belongs to a group, the information is assessed on the ICT services provided by the group as a whole (article 1, paragraph #).
Where the provider belongs to a group, the four criteria are assessed on the ICT services provided by THE GROUP AS A WHOLE.
texte.Là où le RGPD et le cadre se rejoignent: Where the GDPR and the framework meet without overlapping.
texte.Matériel d'entraînement destiné aux pers: Training material intended for the designated persons
texte.Maîtrise des accès physiques aux locaux: Control of physical access to premises
texte.Maîtrise du système et de sa chaîne: Control of the system and its chain
texte.Mesure-t-on ce qui compte, ou ce qui se: Is what counts being measured, or what is easy to measure.
texte.Met un produit à disposition sur le marc: Makes a product available on the market without being either the manufacturer or the importer.
texte.Mettre en place des outils et des procéd: Put in place tools and procedures to defend network and information systems and to manage incidents
texte.Mettre en place un pilotage de la sécuri: Put in place suitable steering of network and information system security, including cybersecurity training for the members of the management bodies and the persons exposed to the risks
texte.Mettre en œuvre des mesures qui abaissen: Implement measures that lower the likelihood, the consequence, or both.
texte.Mise en place après la PREMIÈRE désignat: Set up after the FIRST designation of a provider as critical, by the lead overseer in agreement with the joint oversight network of article #, paragraph #, of DORA. It may be updated in the event of a significant change in the provider's situation.
texte.Mise en œuvre d'un cadre de gouvernance: Implementation of a digital security governance framework
texte.Mise en œuvre des conclusions des tests: Implementation of the conclusions of testing and post-incident analysis, and awareness and training programmes
texte.Mise en œuvre et test de plans d'urgence: Implementation and testing of contingency plans, and ICT security measures, tools and policies of an appropriate level
texte.Mise en œuvre par le déployeur des mesur: Implementation by the deployer of the specified measures
texte.Moins de dix personnes employées, et chi: Fewer than ten persons employed, and annual turnover or balance-sheet total not exceeding # million euros.
texte.Mécanismes d'indépendance du réviseur ma: Independence mechanisms for the manual reviewer
texte.N'enregistrer que la sortie retenue effa: Recording only the output adopted erases the trace of the disagreement, that is, the most useful piece of information the arrangement produces.
texte.NIST AI #-# est une œuvre du gouvernemen: NIST AI #-# is a work of the United States Government: the # statements are reproduced word for word, in English, because that is the wording an auditor will look for. The profile cannot be certified, and it is worth nothing without the AI #-# framework underneath.
texte.NIST AI #-# et AI #-# sont des œuvres du: NIST AI #-# and AI #-# are works of the United States Government: they may be quoted freely. They cannot be certified, and AI #-# is a PROFILE of the framework — quoting it without the framework underneath is quoting the profile of nothing.
texte.Ne pas documenter deux fois ce qu'un seu: Not documenting twice what a single file proves.
texte.Neuf clauses pour tout accord de service: Nine clauses for any ICT services agreement, six more as soon as the function supported is critical or important.
texte.Ni important ni critique : le fabricant: Neither important nor critical: the manufacturer demonstrates conformity itself.
texte.Niveaux de service complets, avec des ob: Full service levels, with precise quantitative and qualitative performance targets allowing effective monitoring and corrective action
texte.Nom et coordonnées de la personne de con: Name and contact details of the contact person
texte.Norme sous droit d'auteur. Numéros et in: Standard under copyright. Control numbers and titles only; no requirement is reproduced.
texte.Notifier aux destinataires des services: Notify the recipients of the services of the significant incidents liable to impair the provision of those services.
texte.On ne cartographie pas ce qu'on ignore :: You cannot map what you do not know about: this screen gives the list of places to look before declaring anything.
texte.On y met des secrets parce que c'est l'e: Secrets get put there because it is the handiest place. The mitigation is not to hide it better: it is to put nothing there that has to stay hidden.
texte.Opérateur de services essentiels identif: Operator of essential services identified before # January # under directive (EU) #/#, if the Member State so provides
texte.Organisme notifié dans tous les cas : le: A notified body in every case: internal control alone is never available.
texte.Outils, méthodes, processus et politique: ICT risk management tools, methods, processes and policies, and the simplified framework. # articles.
texte.PROTÉGÉE PAR LE DROIT D'AUTEUR du CEN et: PROTECTED BY THE COPYRIGHT of CEN and its national members. This module reproduces NO normative sentence: it cites clause numbers and titles, as an index does, and everything else is written by the firm.
texte.PROTÉGÉE PAR LE DROIT D'AUTEUR — © ISO/I: PROTECTED BY COPYRIGHT — © ISO/IEC #, all rights reserved. No part of the normative text is reproduced here: only clause and control numbers and titles are cited, and everything that describes them is written by the firm.
PROTECTED BY COPYRIGHT — © ISO/IEC. No part of the normative text is reproduced here: only clause and control numbers and titles are cited, and everything that describes them is written by the firm.
texte.Participation et coopération pleines au: Full participation and cooperation in the financial entity's threat-led penetration test (articles # and #)
texte.Passage en revue des exigences relatives: Review of the requirements for the AI system
texte.Pendant l'état sécurisé, seules les fonc: During the safe state, only the functions documented as remaining active must be so: everything else is inert, and that is testable.
texte.Perturbation d'un service, coût ou délai: Disruption of one service, a measurable cost or delay, no third party affected.
texte.Peut-on lire sur l'interface, sans se tr: Can the interface be read, without mistake, for where the system stands and whether it is leaving its bounds — and does the control that triggers a mitigation resist an unintended gesture when the scenario calls for it?
texte.Pièce de rechange fabriquée aux mêmes sp: Spare part manufactured to the same specifications as the component it replaces
texte.Planification de la réalisation des obje: Planning to achieve the quality objectives
texte.Plus de # # clients touchés utilisant le: More than # # affected clients using the service
texte.Plus de # % de la valeur moyenne journal: More than # % of the average daily value of transactions
texte.Plus de # % des clients utilisant le ser: More than # % of the clients using the affected service
texte.Plus de # % des contreparties financière: More than # % of the financial counterparties linked to the service
texte.Plus de # % du nombre moyen journalier d: More than # % of the average daily number of transactions
texte.Politique des ressources humaines et con: Human resources policy and access control
texte.Politiques et procédures pour les opérat: Policies and procedures for ICT operations
texte.Politiques, procédures, protocoles et ou: ICT security policies, procedures, protocols and tools
texte.Pour chaque exigence essentielle, l'appr: For each essential requirement, is the approach retained chosen and written down — harmonised standard, common specification, other standard, or other technical solution?
texte.Pour chaque mesure que le déployeur doit: For each measure the deployer must implement, do the instructions for use name the risk addressed, what has to be implemented (technical, procedural, organisational), the measurable performance criteria, the competences required and the recommended verification methods?
texte.Pour chaque traitement : une réponse à c: For each processing operation: an answer to each of the nine criteria, then, as soon as two are met, the severity and likelihood of three feared events.
texte.Pour la PREMIÈRE liste publiée, les rede: For the FIRST list published, the fees are shared in EQUAL PARTS among the designated providers. For the first year of a later designation, the provider pays a flat amount equal to that figure, pro rata to the calendar days of oversight if the year is incomplete.
texte.Pour la réalisation de l'analyse de risq: For carrying out the risk analysis AND the entity's follow-up of the treatment plan that comes out of it. The engagement alone, with no follow-up of the plan, is not enough.
texte.Pour le critère c), la première étape es: For criterion (c), the first step is covered by the assessment of criteria (a), (b) and (d).
texte.Pour les entités financières identifiées: For financial entities identified as essential or important under the national provisions transposing article # of directive (EU) #/#, the regulation is considered a sectoral Union legal act for the purposes of article # of that directive.
texte.Pratiques interdites, classification, do: Prohibited practices, classification, documentation: a gap here ends in a withdrawal from the market, not in an observation.
texte.Prestataire de services sur crypto-actif: Authorised crypto-asset service provider, and issuer of asset-referenced tokens
texte.Principe de proportionnalité : il comman: Principle of proportionality: it governs the reading of all the others, it is not declared on its own.
texte.Production, transformation et distributi: Production, processing and distribution of food
texte.Produit conçu pour traiter des informati: Product designed to process classified information
texte.Produit destiné aux véhicules à moteur e: Product intended for motor vehicles and their trailers
texte.Produit développé ou modifié exclusiveme: Product developed or modified exclusively for national security or defence purposes
texte.Projet de loi relatif à la résilience de: Bill on the resilience of critical infrastructure and the strengthening of cybersecurity (NOR: PRMD#L)
